QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] Root of the Conspiracy
QuestInfo.0: The Goddess of Time, #p2144000#, appeared before you again. What is happening?
QuestInfo.1: To stop #p2144010#'s conspiracy, you need to defeat him.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated #p2144010#'s clone and protected Rhinne. However, the real #p2144010# is still out there. Enter the Dimensional Schism to finish him off.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: Can proceed to [Silent Crusade] The Last Report quest

0.0: Hello again, hero. May I have a moment of your time?\r\n#L0##bWhat's on your mind, Goddess?#l\n#k
0.1: #p2144010# was here a short time ago. There's only one reason for him to be here.\r\n#L0##bWhat is it?#l\n#k
0.2: It is as you feared! #p2144010# is here to break the Black Mage's seal.\r\n#L0##bBut why? Why doesn't he go back further and just stop the seal from getting created in the first place?#l\n#k
0.3: Freud and #p2144006# used all of their power to lock the moment in time when the Black Mage was sealed, just in case anyone tried to interfere. It's impossible to travel further back in time than that moment.\r\n#L0##b(Freud and #p2144006# foresaw this happening? Incredible.)#l\n#k
0.4: If #p2144010# breaks the seal, your world will be doomed. Please protect the Black Mage's seal.

no.0: Is it wise to disobey a goddess?

1.0: You were just in time.\r\n#L0##bI beat #p2144010#! I saved the world, right?#l\n#k
1.1: Not quite. That wasn't the real #p2144010#. He's run to his hideout, the #rDimensional Schism#k. However, most of his power went into creating the Crack in Time... This is your best opportunity to strike at #p2144010#, before he gets his strength back!\r\n#L0##bHow do I get to the Dimensional Schism?#l\n#k
1.2: You can reach the Dimensional Schism through the same #bCrack in Time#k that took you here. Stop #p2144010# from ever trying to free the Black Mage again!

yes.0: As #p2144010# grows weaker, I grow stronger. The portal next to me will return you to the present.

mob.0: There is no time to waste! Defeat #p2144010#, and quickly!
